newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures slip back to nil trades.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures slip back to nil trades.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange wheat futures lapsed back into nil trades on Wednesday after staging a revival on Tuesday.
Settlement prices fell by A$1.50-A$2.00 a tonne across the range of near and distant contracts.
Alan Harris of Elders Risk Management Pty Ltd said that despite Wednesday's quieter market, SFE wheat needed its recent boost following last year's disappointing slide.
Wednesday's tradeless floor performance followed a more active session on the SYCOM overnight system, when May 1997 edged back by 50 cents to A$180.00 a tonne on 10 lots traded.
